beats.t: Got {enemy} at {range}, east ridge, moving now!
My gratitude, friend. I shall investigate.
I see the rogue! Preparing to engage!
Mind their weapon, friend. It is {weapon}.
Copy, grid seven-seven. Moving to intercept.
Negative, they're folding. Now in vehicle mode.
Nay, friend, I believe that is our comrade!
Forgive me! My sensors must need calibration.
Friend {ally}! An enemy robot draws near!
I am ready! Where doth they hide?
At {bearing}, as I live and breathe!
Then let us teach them some manners!
Do exercise caution, friend. Their shield reads {shield}.
Friend {ally}, I spot an enemy at {range}!
I shall attend to them directly.
Their shield is but {shield}, an easy foe!
Where might they be, good friend?
At {bearing}, and they look rather fierce!
Negative, I have {bearing} clear, no contact.
Correction, they moved to the center.
Dear friend {ally}, I require your attention!
I shall make ready to de-rez them!
Wait—{enemy} just folded, moving toward center.
Contact! {enemy} near {bearing}, I've got line of sight.
{enemy} is active at {bearing}, {range}, coming your way.
{ally}, I see {enemy} at {bearing}, looks like {weapon} only.
Copy that, friend. I shall dodge.
I see it. Thank you, friend.
On it, shield at the ready.
Don't go to {bearing}, there's a trap!
I am turning now. Much obliged.
I see them, I see them!
I'm hit! Oh no, I'm hit!
Incomings from the east, friend. Multiple contacts.
Cease advance! {bearing} is not safe, friend.
{enemy} has you in their sights, friend.
Uh, hey {ally}, I think I see someone moving over there!
Wait wait wait, is that an enemy?!
I think so! Look at the color!
Oh no, it's {enemy}! What do we do?!
Oh no oh no, there's something by {bearing}!
It's big and it's {enemy}! And it's got a {weapon}!
Hey {ally}, is this thing supposed to be here?
I see one! I see one! It's {enemy}!
Roger. Hold position and track them.
Should I shoot? There's an enemy by {bearing}!
There's a robot! A bad one! By {bearing}!
I think so! Look at the way it's moving!
Okay that's definitely {enemy}, what do we do?!
Check your six, something's coming fast.
Just one, but they see you.
{enemy} has been spotted at {bearing}. Current range {range}.
Visual confirmed on {enemy}. Bearing {bearing}, range {range}, {shield} shield remaining.
Direct hit on my flank armor.
My weapon's offline after that hit.
{ally}, get down! There's a {weapon} lock at {range}!
{ally}, you've got a visitor. {enemy} closing fast at {range}.
I see them now. Turning to engage.
Watch it, {ally}. Something's coming your way.
Wait—no, that's not {enemy}. That's a friendly!
Copy. {crate} in play. Keep eyes on.
{ally}, they have enough for a new bot. It's now or never!
Got it. Full push. Let's go!
I am in your debt. I shall retaliate.
Friend, the enemy robot has been de-rezzed!
I see them. Thank you, friend.
New contact, repeat new contact! {enemy} near {bearing}!
Copy that {ally}! Taking point, you flank!
Close? How close? Give me numbers, {ally}!
Moving to you thirty seconds out stay alive stay alive
Multiple hits my shields at fifty percent fifty {enemy} is aggressive
On my way {ally} cover you with {weapon}
Taking fire from {bearing} my shields at {shield} need backup now
Retreat to {bearing} crate there rearm rearm
{enemy} got me with {weapon} shields dropping ten percent please respond
Ten seconds ten seconds hold on
Direct hit my shields down to thirty percent {weapon} stream from {enemy}
Where are you what bearing what bearing
Shields failing at {shield} need the crate at {bearing} immediately
Engaging drawing them off hold tight
Taking sustained damage shields at {shield} {enemy} is pouring fire
Copy that area clear move to {bearing}
My shields are critically low fifteen percent fifteen {enemy} pushing hard
Crippled taking fire from two sources shields at five percent five
Good call {ally} I'll cover your retreat
Fold. Fold now. Clear the area.
Elec-tric ar-row. It's com-ing for you, {ally}.
That's not me. Who is it?
Re-d di-rected. Re-d laser. Di-rected at you.
Bla-zing trail. It's com-ing through the mid-dle.
{ally}, drop. Drop to the ground. Now.
Heavy ar-til-ler-y. Big boom. Get down.
Copy, friend. I shall hold the line.
Friend {ally}, be advised, a projectile approaches from {bearing}.
Affirmative, friend. De-rez imminent if you remain.
I am trying! There is debris everywhere!
Stay focused. I shall provide cover.
Heed my words, {ally}. Danger approaches from {bearing}.
I shall shield them. Proceed with caution.
{ally}, what is your status? Is the threat neutralized?
Almost! One more hit and they fold!
Confirmed. I see the muzzle flash.
{ally}, incoming on your flank. Turn and engage.
Now is our chance, friend. Advance!
I see it! Watch this, I've got them!
That was close! Nice call, I'm fine.
I see it! That's {enemy}, I'm on it!
Whoa whoa whoa I'm hit bad is that normal?!
Did I just get de-rezzed? Is that what happened?!
Affirm rookie, you're fine, respawn inbound.
Critical hit received, folding and retreating.
Copy, holding the line for you!
I think I took damage from that weapon, was that {weapon}?!
Affirmative, watch for the splash zone.
Wait was that an enemy or did I hit a wall?!
That was {enemy} for sure, they're low now.
Shield failing, need immediate support at {bearing}.
Negative on support, find cover rookie!
Um my weapons aren't working and I'm not sure what happened.
You got hit by {weapon}, it's a stun effect.
Copy that, form up on my position!
I don't feel so good, things are getting fuzzy...
Stay with me rookie, auto-rez is coming.
Copy, swinging around to flank them!
Focus rookie, find a crate and wait for me.
Enemy {enemy} hit me, my systems are scrambled!
Copy, that's a stun, reinitialize quick!
Is it supposed to feel this bumpy when you get hit?!
That's impact feedback rookie, you're fine.
Multiple hits, shield critical, falling back.
I think I'm glitching, everything's going red!!
Rookie that's low shield, grab a crate!
Wilco, I'm coming to get you!
Hey hey, I see {enemy}! Is that— is that an enemy?
Uh, {ally}? There's a robot— I think it's {enemy}?
I got {enemy} in sight! Should I— should I fire?
Do it! We've got backup inbound.
Okay I see it— oh no, is that {enemy}?
Uh oh. Um. {enemy} is— yeah they're here.
Critical shields here. I am exposed. Please assist.
Shields nearly gone. Cannot engage. Must retreat.
Shield forty-two. No, thirty. Under fire.
Shields critical. I need a window to withdraw.
My systems are failing. Shields at five percent.
Cannot continue. Shields failing rapidly. Must fall back.
My defenses are down. I am open to attack.
Shields are gone. I am vulnerable. Help me.
{enemy} has line of sight on you, {ally}!
{enemy} charging heavy! All units, take cover!
{enemy} locking onto {ally}! Get out of there!
Good friend, my shields dwindle to mere whispers. I implore your aid!
{ally}, shield critical at {range}. Need covering fire now!
Worry not, dear friend. I shall stand guard.
Fair companion, I must retreat. My shields are nearly spent.
Go with speed, my friend. I shall hold this ground.
I beseech thee! My shield crumbles beneath {enemy}'s fury!
Brave friend, I shall cover your retreat!
My shields crack like ancient glass! Pray, protect me!
Courage, friend. I am with you. Hold fast!
I come, dear friend. Do not falter!
My gratitude, friend. My shields were as good as lost.
Any time. Now go gather your strength.
I must withdraw, dear allies. My defenses crumble!
Your courage shines, friend. Go safely.
My shields have failed! I am defenseless!
Stand behind me, brave one. I shall shield you yet.
My shield is at {shield}. Taking heavy fire.
Shield at {range}. Need covering fire to extract.
Down to {shield} shield. Need support or de-rez.
Pull back. I've got your six.
Copy that. Cover fire inbound to your position.
I've been hit by {enemy}. Their {weapon} is hitting hard.
Hit! {enemy} landed a clean shot on me.
I'm taking heavy fire from {bearing} position.
Copy. Engaging {enemy} to draw fire off you.
Taking damage here. Need backup at {bearing}.
Copy. That's {enemyteam}'s loadout. I see them at {bearing}.
My bad — shields at {shield}, I'm still up.
Copy. Hold position, {ally}. Crate inbound to your location.
I'm taking fire from the ridge. Looks like {enemy} has me locked.
Thanks. I can hold for ten seconds.
Copy. Retreat to {bearing}, I'll cover you.
{enemy} just lit me up. I'm at {shield} shield.
Copy. I've got eyes on them. Returning fire now.
Taking damage! {enemy} is unloading on me at {bearing}!
I'm hit! Shield dropping fast! Twenty percent!
My armor - gone! I'm exposed out here!
Got me! Got me! Taking damage from {bearing}!
My systems - sparks everywhere! {enemy} nailed me!
You're being focused! Get behind cover!
Ouch! That one hurt! Damage report: thirty percent gone!
What hit you? Identify the threat!
Taking sustained fire! This {enemy} won't stop!
How bad? Give me a number!
Pull back. I've got the angle.
{ally} I'm pinned down! Can you can you come help?
On my way, friend! Hold fast!
Copy! I'm en route, I'm en route!
Need some cover here, {ally}! They're swarming!
I'm coming, friend! Providing fire support!
{ally}, my shields are failing. Requesting aid!
Got it! On my way, on my way!
{ally} I'm out of ammo! Can you can you cover me?
Affirmative! I'll draw their fire, friend.
{ally}, I am surrounded. Need immediate backup!
Negative, can't break through! Can you you can fold?
I'm engaged! Find another way, friend!
There's no no other way! Help!
Can someone can someone watch my back?
I've got you, friend. Enemy at {bearing}.
{ally}, I could use your armaments here!
I can't I can't hold this position!
What do you need, what do you need?
Draw their attention whilst I reload!
Please, friend. I can help turn the tide!
Anyone got a a line on {enemy}?
{ally}, my vehicle is damaged. Require assistance!
Can you can you still move?
Slowly. I shall require a shield.
I'm here, friend. What's your position?
{ally}, would you be so kind as to assist?
Yep yep! What do you need?
Keep {enemy} busy whilst I fetch the crate.
I'm down to {shield}! This is bad!
Retreat to {bearing}, friend! I'll cover you!
{ally}, I find myself in a spot of trouble!
On it! What's your your status?
Shields at {shield}. Need a moment to recover.
I'll keep them busy! Go go go!
My {weapon} is offline! They got my arm!
Oh, sorry! Thought it was lower!
Hit! {enemy} hit me at close range!
I know! {enemy} caught me off guard!
Copy, it's just the weapon, right?
Need backup at {bearing}, taking heavy fire.
Requesting weapon support, {ally} can you draw their fire?
Providing cover fire. Move when ready.
{ally} can you assist with this {crate}? I am alone.
I am out of ammo, {ally} please provide supporting fire.
We need more firepower, {ally} push with me.
I cannot hold this position alone, {ally} assist please.
Requesting assist on {enemy}, I have lost track.
Need backup NOW, {ally}! {enemy} is all over me!
Leave {enemy} to me! I'm the best around!
{ally}, I need fire support at {bearing}, stat!
Copy. In position in twenty seconds.
Hurry up! {enemy} is not playing nice!
{ally}, taking heavy fire. Request immediate assistance.
Way ahead of you! Hold on!
{ally}, where are you? I'm getting overwhelmed here!
{ally}, moving to assist. What's your status?
Shields at {shield}! Get over here fast!
{ally}, need cover to reload! {enemy} is coming!
Consider it done! Watch a master work!
{ally}, I'm low on {shield}. Need a window.
On it! I love a good fight!
Copy. Moving to block. You safe?
Copy. Go low. I cover high.
I see them. You're clear to fold.
This unit cannot hold. Shields down.
Stay low. I'll draw their fire.
Nice! Did you see that coming {ally}?
{ally}, is that a de-rez? Did I get them?
Thanks! That was a close fight.
{ally}, did I get them? Is it over?
Did you see that {ally}? I got them!
Wait, is {enemy} gone? They're gone right?
Shield critical. Taking heavy fire from {enemy}.
Shield failing fast. Need cover now.
I am hard pressed at {bearing}, friends. Assistance would be most welcome.
Copy that! Moving to intercept, ETA {range}!
Help help help! {enemy} got the drop on me!
Location, friend! Where do you stand?
{bearing}! By the crate, I'm at {shield} shield!
I see you. On my way.
Companions, I require aid against {enemy} at {bearing}.
Got it! Dropping what I'm doing!
Anyone near {bearing}? I'm in trouble here!
I am nearby. What assistance is needed?
{enemy} is tearing me up! Cover me!
I'm coming! How many, how many?
Three of the enemy, my friend.
Need {ally} to draw fire! I'm reloading!
Help! My {weapon} is jammed and {enemy} is coming!
Do not panic, friend. I shall intercept.
Companion at {bearing}, I require your lance.
Courage, friend. You are not alone.
I need a distraction at {bearing}. Anyone available?
Thank you thank you! Hurry though!
I find myself in a precarious situation near {bearing}.
{enemy} has me corned. I require a rescue.
On it! Stay alive, I'm coming!
Friends, my systems are damaged. I need cover to retreat.
Copy! Taking point, you fall back!
My thanks, friend. I owe you a favor.
How many opponents do you face?
Two! No wait, three! Three enemies!
I shall engage. Hold your ground.
Anyone willing to assist a fellow warrior?
{ally}, I'm critically low on shield! Help!
Fall back! I shall cover your retreat.
Thank you! You're saving my life!
I shall cover thy retreat, dear friend.
Copy that. What's our next target?
I spy another near the central vault.
{ally}, the {enemy} has been sent to the scrap heap!
A blow well struck, {ally}! The {enemy} folds at last.
A splendid notion. Lead on, brave friend.
Fret not, friend. The supply drop approaches.
The {enemy} is de-rezzed, {ally}! Victory is ours!
A worthy foe, but de-rezzed nonetheless, {ally}!
East ridge, my friend. Two hostiles remain.
{ally} is out. We're at half strength now.
We can still win this. Need a crate.
Moving toward center. Keep eyes open.
We lost {ally}. Anyone have line on {enemy}?
{ally} is down. We need to regroup.
Negative. Hold position. We have {shield} shields.
Team down one. Who has weapon?
Copy. We'll get revenge. Where are they?
Copy. Stay tight. Two is enough.
{ally} just fell. What is our status?
Two up. We hold the center.
Negative. We press. We have {gold} gold.
{enemy} has me locked down near {bearing}, request flanking assistance.
{ally}, I'm overextended near {bearing}, need rescue support.
Providing cover at {range}, reloading when ready.
Crate at {bearing} is contested, need assistance securing it.
Falling back to {bearing}, setting up defensive perimeter.
Extraction point set at {bearing}, moving to your location.
{ally}, I've isolated {enemy} near {bearing}, need help finishing.
{ally}, I'm stuck in vehicle mode near {bearing}, need escort to fold.
Goldcrate at {bearing} needs protection, {enemyteam} is approaching.
{ally} just popped. We'll get them back.
Hey {ally}, save me! Too many enemies!
{ally}, I'm surrounded at {bearing}. Requesting immediate help.
{ally}, my weapon is offline. Need cover.
Oh wow oh wow, did you see that?! {enemy} just folded!
Was that a good shot? Tell me that was a good shot!
Oh thank circuits, I thought I missed!
Checking gold. We need {gold} more for backup.
I got them! I actually got them! {enemy} is gone!
All systems green! Ready to engage.
So... am I doing good? Is this how it's supposed to go?
You're doing great. Keep it up.
Did I help? Was that useful?
That felt right, right? I did the thing properly?
{enemy} is de-rezzed. Confirm you saw it, {ally}.
One less problem to worry about!
How long until {ally} comes back? Do they come back soon?
A brief respite, friend. Prepare thyself in the meantime.
I saw it happen, I saw {enemy} get them, it was so fast!
The fault lies not with thee, friend. {enemy} is cunning.
We should go get {enemy} right now, we should avenge them!
Patience, friend. Let us secure the crate whilst {ally} returns.
Was that okay? Was my fighting okay? I tried my best!
Thou wert magnificent, friend. The fault belongs to {enemy}.
Wait, do we have enough gold for another robot? Do we?
We possess {gold}, friend. All shall be well.
{enemy} is moving toward {bearing}, I think they're pushing!
Excellent intelligence, friend. We shall intercept them.
What happened? I didn't see what happened, one second they were there!
{enemy} flanked via {bearing}, friend. A costly lesson.
I'm sorry, I'm so sorry, I should have been watching {ally}'s back!
Thou hast nothing to apologise for, friend. War is chaotic.
What do you need me to do? Should I guard or attack or what?
Hold the centre, friend. I shall pursue {enemy}.
When {ally} comes back, we should all stay together this time!
A wise strategy, friend. Strength in unity.
There's a {crate} dropping soon, should we go for it without {ally}?
Indeed, friend. We shall claim it and return with weapons aplenty.
Maybe we should wait here until {ally} gets back? Just to be safe?
Nay, friend. We must press forward. Hesitation yields defeat.
Is it just me and you now? Just the two of us against {enemyteam}?
A gallant pair, friend. We shall triumph regardless.
{ally} is coming back! I can see them rematerializing!
Excellent tidings, friend. Welcome back to the fray!
There's three of them! Wait, no, I count four! Five!
Two are already de-rezzed, friend. We have the advantage.
I'll cover you while you get the {crate}, I'll be your shield!
Brave friend, I shall not forget thy sacrifice.
What's our best weapon right now? Should I switch to something else?
Thy current {weapon} serves well, friend. Trust thy training.
Where should I position myself? Here at {bearing} or closer to you?
Join me at {bearing}, friend. We shall weather this storm together.
We can still win this, right? We can still come back and win?
Always, friend. The arena favours the bold and the steadfast.

{ally}, charge is gone. How long until rematerialize?
Pistol only until reload. Cover me.
Charge depleted. What is our status?
Copy. Holding position until weapon ready.
Did I do that right? I had to switch guns, was that okay?
You're fine, you're fine! Just hurry up, we've got contact.
Primary weapon offline. Reverting to secondary.
Arming now. Thirty seconds to full combat ready.
My gun's out! I need to switch, I need to switch!
Just do it! We've got a {crate} incoming, grab it after!
Main weapon exhausted. Cycling to sidearm.
Is it bad that my weapon timed out? Should I be worried?
No no, it's normal! Just switch and get back in.
I can't shoot anymore! What do I do, what do I do?!
Switch weapons! You've got another one, just press the button!
Okay okay, I'm doing it, I'm doing it!
Shield failing, friend! Requesting cover at {bearing}!
My shield dwindles, friend! {enemy} presses hard!
Copy. Returning fire, you pull back.
My shield buckles, dear friend! {enemy} advances!
I shall provide cover, remain steadfast!
Friend, my shield cannot hold much longer!
Copy, {ally}. Fall back, I've got you.
I implore thee, cover my retreat!
My shield fails me! I must retreat!
A noble strike! {enemy} has been de-rezzed.
I have struck down {enemy}! A fair blow.
Fear not, {ally}! The enemy is de-rezzed.
All is well, friend. I stand ready.
Copy. Let's keep the pressure on.
Thou art a credit to the arena!
{enemy} is no more! A clean strike!
The crate is falling... near the center.
I've got you, {ally}, holding fire at {range}!
Going for the crate... be there soon.
Climbing the center tower, anyone with me? {weapon} ready!
Copy that, switching to {bearing}, got it!
Enemy approaching crate... preparing to deny.
Wait, no, {enemy} at {range}, changing plan, heading to {bearing}!
Falling back, falling back, {enemy} has {weapon} and I'm at {shield}!
{ally} and {ally}, push north flank, go go go!
Wait for me, {ally}, I'm folding up here!
Flanking left through {bearing}, {ally} hold the center!
One crate left. Enemy has two.
We need that last one... got it?
I'm coming {ally}, just at {range}, hold on!
Falling back to base, everyone to {bearing}!
Switching to {bearing}, {enemy} pushed our flank, regroup!
Got it, falling back, {ally} you first!
Going high through {bearing}, elevated position, cover my climb!
Right behind you {ally}, got my {weapon} up!
Got it {ally}, I'm at {shield}, heading your way!

{ally}, my railgun's dry! Get me a crate!
Copy. Supply drop at {bearing}, thirty seconds.
Weapon systems offline. Reconfiguring to secondary.
Hah, slop for you. I've got ammo for days!
Empty! Switching to sidearm. Cover me!
{ally}, weapon timer at ten seconds. Need distance.
Got it. I'll hold the lane.
Out of juice! {ally}, fetch me a crate!
On it. {crate} inbound to your position.
Weapon cycling. Exposed for five. Need cover.
Focus. Get a new weapon. Now.
Empty! This gun eats ammo for breakfast!
Primary weapon dry. Moving to backup.
The circuit has gone dark for {ally}.
Their memory lives on in us.
One of us has folded... into the void.
{ally} returns to the arena in light.
Alphaactual, advancing to the north ridge. Advise all units.
Copy. Holding the center. Moving to support.
Friend, I shall scale the western tower for the high ground!
A noble stratagem! I shall hold the passage below.

Excellent! We shall draw their fire while you strike.
I shall provide support from the heights, friend.
All units, reposition to the south flank. Copy?
Wilco. En route to the southern approach.
Copy. Moving to flank from the south.

I shall cover your retreat, my friend. Go with haste!

Copy. Standing by for your call.

We shall follow your banner, friend!
{ally}, pushing left flank. Cover my advance.
Copy. Flanking left. Give them something to worry about.

I owe you a debt of gratitude, friend. Retreating now.
Bearing to the east ridge. Holding this position.
Copy. Advise if you need reinforcement.
Friends, I shall make my stand at the central platform!
Then we shall stand with you, friend!
A glorious position! We shall not abandon you.
Fall back! All units fall back to the rally point!
Moving to the west wall. Setting up overwatch.
I shall circle behind the enemy! Watch for my signal!
A daring maneuver, friend! We await your call.
{ally}, reposition to my location. Double up.
Copy. On my way. Thirty seconds.
The path upward beckons! I climb to the summit!
Fortune favors the bold, friend! Ascend with our blessing!
Advancing to the crate. Cover me.
Copy. Moving to intercept any who approach.
Affirm. Providing overwatch on your advance.
My gun my gun it's not working anymore!
Just switch weapons you have other ones!
Is it okay is it okay that I switched?
I'm switching I'm switching to the cannon!
Good idea good idea cover me!
Out of ammo, need a crate.
Fear not, friend. We shall hold the line.
It was {enemy}, I saw it, I saw it!
Very well. We shall remember this.
It's just us now, it's just us!
Steady yourself, friend. Two is enough.
But a moment, friend. Have faith.
A modest sum, friend. We shall recover it.
I'm going to get {enemy} for this!
I shall join you, friend. Justice awaits.
This is bad, this is really bad!
Compose yourself, friend. All is not lost.
Noted. The debt shall be paid.
I need cover to fall back, please!
I shall provide it, friend. Retreat with honor.
I froze, I didn't see them coming!
It happens to the bravest, friend. Breathe.
They're going to come for me next!
Not while I stand guard, friend. You are safe.
We should push together, right? Right?!
A sound notion, friend. On my mark.
Where did the misdeed take place?
Any moment now, friend. Trust the process.
We lost so much gold from that!
Gold is replaceable, friend. Heroes are not.
I shall accompany you, friend. Strength in unity.
Gather yourself, friend. The battle continues.
Okay, okay, I'm okay, I'm good.
What's the status on the supply drop?
Landing in thirty seconds. East side.
I have the crate. Weapon is {weapon}.
Supply drop at {bearing}. ETA twenty seconds.
Need escort to extract the crate.

Repositioning to {bearing}, circle around, circle around!

Sneaking around, quiet, quiet, going wide left!

Shifting to the left flank, repositioning, hold tight!

No worries, I'll rip them apart for you!

Hurry up! I'm getting bored over here!

Hurry up! This is taking forever!

Primary weapon draining. Switching to secondary.

Main weapon offline. Switching to secondary. Need support fire.
